name: G-PCC PlenOctree Compression
definition: A compression technique for PlenOctree models that encodes the geometry losslessly and the attributes (opacity σ and spherical harmonic coefficients k) lossily using Geometry-based Point Cloud Coding (G-PCC) standards, specifically utilizing RAHT or Predlift transforms for attribute coding.
summary: G-PCC PlenOctree Compression treats PlenOctree voxels as a point cloud, using G-PCC standards to losslessly encode geometry and lossily encode attributes via RAHT or Predlift transforms.
